verdict.rationale: Ramp's own Treasury docs say Checking Account deposits get FDIC insurance 'up to tens of millions of dollars per depositor' through IntraFi's ICS service, which covers the core goal of extended FDIC coverage without user action. However, the evidence never describes how deposits are swept across partner banks or how that is automated. missing for 10: documented sweep mechanics across partner banks, a partner bank list or allocation controls, opt-out or exclusion settings, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can have deposits automatically swept across partner banks to maximize FDIC insurance coverage

citations.quote: deposits in a Ramp Checking Account receive FDIC insurance up to tens of millions of dollars per depositor
